chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Sofia, 2016: Arsenal and Ludogorets are level near the end. Mohamed Elneny sends a long ball over the defence. Mesut Özil is through! He lifts it over the keeper, sends two defenders sliding... and rolls it in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. One soft touch slows the ball down. The keeper rushes out, so Özil dinks it over him!

chapters.label: The fake
chapters.text: Two defenders race back to guard the goal. Özil pretends to shoot. They both slide... and he calmly rolls it past them into the net!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay calm in front of goal. One more touch can send the defenders sliding past!
